proposition: Using a Scientific Claim Record reduces unsupported completion claims in comparable Monad engineering tasks.

falsification.condition: The record-assisted group has an equal or higher unsupported-completion rate than the control group.
falsification.measurement: Blind reviewers count completion statements not supported by the predefined acceptance evidence.

procedure: Pre-register ten comparable engineering tasks and their acceptance evidence.
Randomly assign five tasks to ordinary workflow and five to claim-record-assisted workflow.
Have operators complete the tasks without seeing the scoring rubric.
Give blinded independent reviewers the outputs and preserved evidence.
Compare unsupported-completion claims per task and publish all exclusions.
protocol.success_threshold: At least 30% fewer unsupported-completion claims in the assisted group.
protocol.failure_threshold: No reduction, or any increase, in the assisted group.

criticism: Ten tasks may be too small to distinguish the record from operator skill.
Reviewers may disagree on what counts as adequate acceptance evidence.
The record may improve reporting while leaving actual task quality unchanged.

history.change: Created a falsifiable worked example; no experiment has been run.
